units: <cite ref="Shabbat 11a:2">Sabb. 11ᵃ</cite>; a. e. <he>כא׳ לנעורת</he> as destructive as fire to the flax.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:8">Gen. R. s. 39</cite> <he>מבול של א׳</he> (v. <cite ref="M00079"><he>מַבּוּל</he></cite>) destruction by fire.—
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:24">Num. R. s. 2</cite> end <he>א׳ הדיוטית</he> fire from outside of the sanctuary; a. fr.—Pl. <he>אִשּׁוֹת</he>.
